[P2] Preserve SDK outcomes when completion reporting fails

If this publication or the following `publish_observation` fails after `invoke()` returns, the surrounding exception handler records `WRAPPER_RAISE` and raises the storage error, discarding the SDK response and potentially triggering an artificial retry. Publication in the exception path can also replace the original SDK exception. Separate completion publication from SDK exception classification and contain sink failures as observation errors. Add handler-level regressions preserving both returned results and raised SDK exceptions; the `ObservedClient` tests do not cover this boundary.
